basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a 31-year-old passionate about gaming, mental health advocacy, and social justice. Originally from the Midwest, I've recently moved to the West Coast to work as a software developer in a tech startup. In my spare time, I dive deep into RPGs, especially Final Fantasy, and enjoy photography as a therapeutic hobby. I'm single and open to meeting new people who share similar interests. My online activity peaks during late evenings and weekends, often fueled by a good cup of coffee.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and a minor in Psychology. My passion for mental health advocacy stems from personal experiences and extensive reading. I keep myself updated on current events and policies through discussions and debates on subreddits like 'PoliticalSparring'.
